## A Revolution in Continuous Respiratory Monitoring

Proactive Care Like Never Before

Predictive modeling using leading Spire Remote Patient Monitoring System data delivers AI-powered insights for proactive interventions, redefining the standard of quality and responsiveness of patient care.

[How it Works](https://www.wellinks.com/spire)

Patients enrolled in Wellinks receive continuous, tailored care that meets them where they are–personalized and designed to seamlessly support their health.

![An example image of the Spire tag being placed on trousers - Wellinks Images](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6807add5e6b0de6ae2ab2fa4_Spire_Health_Tag_Placement.webp)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6807ae24f4a1724b4e4c848e_green%20check%20circle.svg)

**The Health Tag, a first-of-its-kind wearable continuous respiratory sensor,** discreetly attaches to a patient’s clothing and tracks respiration, pulse rate, and activity providing unparalleled visibility into patient health.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6807ae24f4a1724b4e4c848e_green%20check%20circle.svg)

**With real-time predictive insights,** the Health Tag monitors physiological data and detects deviations in a patient’s respiratory baseline before symptoms escalate, enabling early intervention to reduce hospitalizations.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6807ae24f4a1724b4e4c848e_green%20check%20circle.svg)

**Our dedicated clinical care team** analyzes real-time data and intervenes proactively in coordination with patients, their providers, and caregivers – preventing exacerbations before they happen.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6807ae24f4a1724b4e4c848e_green%20check%20circle.svg)

**Wellinks is an extension of a patient's support network, providing support in between provider visits.** Our clinical care team bridges the gap between at-home monitoring and clinical intervention.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6807af03f10a1832af035c3e_Patient-Clinician.svg)
